card_scores.rationale: The opposing-concerns frame, concessive disagreement, numbered replies, informal aside, and parallel closing summary reinforce a specific structured-but-personal argumentative register.
Direct syntax, ordinary transitions, single-focus paragraphs, brief qualifications, and concise restatement form a consistent but broadly neutral expository style.
Explicit uncertainty, evidential calibration, bounded contrast, restrained progression, and parallel categories jointly define a cautious analytical-disagreement register.
High-commitment theses, corrective reframing, purpose-bounded criticism, consequence lists, and reader-facing distinction markers create a forceful corrective register.
Guiding questions, parallel categories, evidential maturity, bounded examples, and consequence-before-mechanism explanation cohere as an evidence-led evaluative register.
Decisive evaluations, concession before disagreement, purpose-bounded criticism, replacement framing, and ordered consequences reinforce a sharply corrective yet qualified register.

Guiding questions, corrective reframing, consequence lists, parallel categories, reader cues, and evidential calibration support a distinctive analytical-evaluative profile, though they span several organizational modes.
